This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] wandering [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] who lived thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point during his life, the trader transported a dangerous [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]]&mdash;known as the [[Darkstaff]]&mdash;to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oblis]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].
